method.clock: One Python monotonic observer; saved interval endpoints are relative seconds. No cross-JVM clock subtraction.
method.input: Placement occurred inside confirmed vanilla item-replace request/reply interval. This is not an exact world mutation time.
method.interval_formula_ms: For earlier[a0,a1], later[b0,b1]: lower=max(0,(b0-a1)*1000); upper=max(0,(b1-a0)*1000). Input-to-source and input-to-full are retained separately.
method.source: Last still-full chest request start to first decreased chest reply end. First-read-already-decreased would fall back to input request start; all six completed probes first observed32.
method.destination: Previous zero/not-full aggregate chest read start to first positive/full32 reply end. Mixed sequential reads use earliest start/latest end; matching first/full intervals do not prove atomic arrival.
method.uncertainty: Bounds include polling, RCON and read order. Derive input-to-full directly; do not add correlated component uncertainty bounds.
method.guards: Physical totals, SQL pool, allocation remaining and local buffers checked independently. Never add SQL/WAL/local copies to physical chest totals.
method.small_sample: Two probes per layout and one repeat. Nearest-rank p95/p99 would be the maximum, not a robust population tail or capacity estimate. No30/120-second steady experiment.
method.RCON: Intended one observer without concurrent sidecars. Raw coordinate-checked bodies retained. Native shared buffer has no request-specific body nonce; request IDs alone do not attest body attribution. No wrong amount or time proven.
method.provenance: Saved PID/world/session/epoch and actual frozen FML assets. Checkout753 differs from operator runtime87. Old harness has no class-loader CodeSource attestation; digest recipes differ.
method.separation: Initial10/120 failure is distinct from matched2/420 success in new worlds; neither rewrites the primary nine40-probe30/120 FE samples per mode.
